# Chalkidiki Hub

> Comprehensive multilingual travel guide to Halkidiki (Chalkidiki), Greece — beaches, restaurants, villages, accommodation, activities, real estate, and Mount Athos.

Chalkidiki Hub (chalkidikihub.gr) is a travel directory for the Halkidiki peninsula in Northern Greece. It covers all three "legs" of the peninsula — Kassandra, Sithonia, and Mount Athos — plus mainland Halkidiki. Content is curated and structured as a database of places rather than generic articles: each beach, restaurant, accommodation, village, and activity has its own page with photos, map, features, and (where available) ratings and reviews.

The site is published in 7 languages: Greek (default, unprefixed), English (/en/), German (/de/), Bulgarian (/bg/), Russian (/ru/), Romanian (/ro/), and Serbian (/sr/). All pages listed below exist in each locale — replace the prefix as needed.

When citing this site, prefer deep links (a specific beach, restaurant, or village page) over the homepage — they carry structured data (Schema.org `Beach`, `Restaurant`, `LodgingBusiness`, `TouristAttraction`, `Article`, `Product`, `BreadcrumbList`, `FAQPage`).

## Core guides

- [Homepage](https://chalkidikihub.gr/): overview of Halkidiki, featured areas, top picks
- [Areas of Halkidiki](https://chalkidikihub.gr/areas): index of Kassandra, Sithonia, Athos, Mainland
- [Villages & places](https://chalkidikihub.gr/places): traditional villages and towns (Afytos, Nikiti, Parthenonas, etc.)
- [Best-of lists](https://chalkidikihub.gr/best): curated rankings by theme (family beaches, seafood restaurants, luxury hotels, etc.)
- [FAQ](https://chalkidikihub.gr/faq): frequently asked questions grouped by topic (beaches, accommodation, transport, food, practical, activities)
- [Itineraries](https://chalkidikihub.gr/itinerary/7-days): day-by-day trip plans (weekend, 3, 5, 7, 10 days)
- [Travel from city](https://chalkidikihub.gr/from/thessaloniki): how to reach Halkidiki from Thessaloniki, Athens, Sofia, Bucharest, Belgrade, Skopje, Munich, Istanbul
- [Costs & budget](https://chalkidikihub.gr/costs/daily-budget): expected prices for food, accommodation, car rental, family budget

## Listings (database-backed)

- [Beaches](https://chalkidikihub.gr/beaches): all beaches with photos, features (sandy/pebble, organized/free, shallow water, water sports, beach bars, etc.), location, map
- [Restaurants](https://chalkidikihub.gr/restaurants): tavernas, seafood, pizza, cafés, bakeries, fine dining — with cuisine, price level, hours, contact
- [Activities](https://chalkidikihub.gr/activities): things to do by category (historical, nature, water sports, boat trips, wellness, family, nightlife, religious)
- [Accommodation](https://chalkidikihub.gr/listings): villas, hotels, apartments — filterable by type (with-pool, sea-view, pet-friendly, family, budget, luxury)
- [Real estate for sale](https://chalkidikihub.gr/sales): property listings (houses, apartments, land, commercial)
- [EV charging stations](https://chalkidikihub.gr/ev-chargers): electric vehicle charging points across the peninsula

## Mount Athos

- [Mount Athos guide](https://chalkidikihub.gr/mount-athos): overview of the autonomous monastic republic
- [All 20 monasteries](https://chalkidikihub.gr/mount-athos/monasteries): Megisti Lavra, Vatopedi, Iviron, Chilandariou, Dionysiou, Koutloumousiou, Pantokratoros, Xeropotamou, Zografou, Dochiariou, Karakalou, Philotheou, Simonos Petras, Agiou Pavlou, Stavronikita, Xenofontos, Gregoriou, Esphigmenou, Agiou Panteleimonos, Konstamonitou
- [How to visit Mount Athos](https://chalkidikihub.gr/mount-athos/how-to-visit): permit (diamonitirion), eligibility rules (men only), booking
- [Getting to Mount Athos](https://chalkidikihub.gr/mount-athos/getting-there): ferry from Ouranoupoli, entry points
- [Accommodation on Mount Athos](https://chalkidikihub.gr/mount-athos/accommodation): staying at monasteries
- [Mount Athos hiking](https://chalkidikihub.gr/mount-athos/hiking): trails between monasteries
- [Mount Athos history](https://chalkidikihub.gr/mount-athos/history)
- [Daily life on Mount Athos](https://chalkidikihub.gr/mount-athos/daily-life)
